{'translation': '聽聽 9to5Mac 為你回顧今日頭條新聞。9to5Mac Daily 喺 iTunes、Apple Podcasts、Stitcher、TuneIn、Google Play 都聽得到，用 Overcast 或者其他 podcast 播放器嘅話亦可以經過我哋嘅 RSS feed 收聽。', 'source': 'Listen to 9to5Mac as we recap the top news stories of the day. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn, Google Play, or through our RSS feed for Overcast and other podcast players.'}

{'translation': '本集由 Stuff 贊助：Stuff 幫你將腦入面所有嘢整理到一個簡單、優雅嘅系統入面——清晒堆積嘅待辦事項，減少精神壓力。一個簡單嘅待辦清單，支援 iPhone、iPad 同 Mac，配備強大工具，令你整理、追蹤、完成任務嘅過程更加有滿足感。靠 Stuff 搞掂所有嘢。', 'source': 'This episode is sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you organize everything in your head into one simple, elegant system—clearing the backlog of to-dos and reducing mental stress. A simple to-do list for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with powerful tools that make organizing, tracking, and completing tasks more satisfying. Get stuff done with Stuff.'}

{'translation': '9to5Mac Daily 逢星期一至五錄製新集。喺 Apple Podcast 或者你最鍾意嘅 podcast 播放器訂閱我哋，保證新集一出即時送到你耳邊。', 'source': '9to5Mac Daily is recorded new every Monday through Friday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast player to make sure you get episodes as soon as they go live.'}

{'translation': '本集討論嘅新聞：', 'source': 'Stories discussed in this episode:'}

  • {'translation': '【報導指 Apple 生產咗幾多部 iPhone Duo】', 'source': '[Report claims how many iPhone Duos Apple has produced]'}
  • {'translation': '【iFixit 拆解新 AirPods 5，首次揭示真正可維修性嘅改進】', 'source': '[iFixit tears down new AirPods 5, first to reveal real repairability improvements]'}
  • {'translation': '【DoorDash 而家可以喺 Apple Messages 用文字落單】', 'source': '[DoorDash can now take orders via text in Apple Messages]'}

{'translation': '歡迎寫信到 happyhour@9to5mac.com 俾我哋。你亦可以喺 Apple Podcasts 為我哋評分，或者喺 Overcast 推薦我哋，幫助更多人發現呢個節目。', 'source': 'Send in your thoughts via email to happyhour@9to5mac.com. You can also rate us on Apple Podcasts or recommend us in Overcast to help others discover the show.'}
